prompts.text: Name a type of musical instrument

items.quip: Wooden tongue bowed on a block to sound like a talking animal.
items.title: Daxophone
items.extract: The daxophone, invented by Hans Reichel, is an electric wooden experimental musical instrument of the friction idiophones category.

items.quip: Twelve-foot bass so tall its player works levers from a platform.
items.title: Octobass
items.extract: The octobass is an extremely large and rare bowed string instrument, a larger three-stringed version of the double bass, first drafted by J.A. Dubois in 1834 and built around 1850 in Paris by the French luthier Jean-Baptiste Vuillaume (1798–1875). The specimen in the collection of the Musée de la Musique in Paris - the only surviving original made by Vuillaume - measures 3.48 metres in length, whereas a full-size double bass is generally approximately 2 m in length.

prompts.text: Name a vegetable that's botanically a fruit

items.quip: Andean slipper gourd stuffed like a pepper in Bolivian kitchens.
items.title: Cyclanthera pedata
items.extract: Cyclanthera pedata, known as caigua, is a herbaceous vine grown for its edible fruit, which is predominantly used as a vegetable. It is known from cultivation only, and its use goes back many centuries as evidenced by ancient phytomorphic ceramics from Peru depicting the fruits.

items.quip: Grape-sized Mexican cucumber that tastes of lime and looks like a watermelon.
items.title: Melothria scabra
items.extract: Melothria scabra, commonly known as the cucamelon, Mexican miniature watermelon, Mexican sour cucumber, Mexican sour gherkin, mouse melon, or pepquino, is a species of flowering plant in the cucurbit family grown for its edible fruit. Its native range spans Mexico to Venezuela. Fruits are about the size of grapes and taste like cucumbers with a tinge of sourness. It may have been eaten by indigenous peoples before the European colonization of the Americas began.

prompts.text: Name a city with the word "City" in its name (like Mexico City)

items.quip: Idaho town of two dozen beside the first reactor to light bulbs.
items.title: Atomic City (U2 song)
items.extract: "Atomic City" is a song by Irish rock band U2, released as a single on 29 September 2023 through Island Records. It was produced by Jacknife Lee and Steve Lillywhite, and was recorded at Sound City Studios. The song was written as a promotional tie-in to the band's U2:UV Achtung Baby Live concert residency at Sphere in the Las Vegas Valley, and it was released the same day the residency began.

items.quip: Indiana boomtown named for the 1880s natural gas strike.
items.title: Gas City, Indiana
items.extract: Gas City is a city in Grant County, Indiana, United States, along the Mississinewa River. The population was 6,157 at the 2020 census.

items.quip: Florida growers have sold juice under the duck's name since the 1940s.
Clinton Foods' 1940s frozen concentrate that fought Minute Maid for freezers.

prompts.text: Name a piece of baking equipment

items.quip: A hollow ceramic blackbird that vents steam through the pie crust.
items.title: Pie bird
items.description: Hollow ceramic device used to support or vent pies
items.extract: A pie bird, pie vent, pie whistle, pie funnel, or pie chimney is a hollow ceramic device, originating in Europe, shaped like a funnel, chimney, or upstretched bird with open beak used for supporting or venting a pie. Some devices whistle when releasing steam. Occasionally other whimsical shapes are used.

items.quip: Wooden block the hot-water pastry is hand-raised around.

prompts.text: Name an animal whose name ends in Y

items.quip: Rabbit-eared Australian marsupial sold as chocolate instead of Easter bunnies.
items.title: Macrotis
items.extract: Macrotis is a genus of desert-dwelling marsupial omnivores known as bilbies or rabbit-bandicoots; they are members of the order Peramelemorphia.

items.quip: Fluffy-looking Japanese sea slug whose ears are chemical sensors.
items.title: Jorunna parva
items.extract: Jorunna parva, commonly known as the sea bunny, is a species of nudibranch, a shell-less marine gastropod mollusc in the family Discodorididae. The species was first described by Kikutaro Baba. Due to its resemblance to a rabbit, there was an increase in the popularity of the species on Twitter throughout Japan in 2015.
